common.style_usage: Stardew Valley building pixel art: palette, outline weight, how the roofs are shaded in rows of tiles or shingles with light ridges, dark gable edges and deep shadow under the eaves, and the high top-down front camera where the roof fills over half the building
common.reference_usage: camera, silhouette and roof planes: the lighter roof colour is roof facing up toward the viewer, the darker is roof facing forward, the darkest band is the shadow under the eaves; keep this outline, these openings, and the roof taking more than half the height

vale_house_s1.description: The Vale House, a two-storey country inn and tea room in Stardew Valley pixel art: a big plum-purple tiled roof in rows with light ridge highlights and darker lower rows, two small dormer windows, a brick chimney, deep shadow under the eaves; warm cream plaster walls with dark timber beams, upstairs windows with flower boxes, a covered wooden porch over a wide front door, an inn sign hanging from a bracket with a painted purple thistle, two lanterns, potted heather by the steps. Seen from above and in front like the Stardew Valley town buildings, a steep front-gabled roof whose ridge runs back away from the viewer, two big shingled roof planes (lit on the left, shaded on the right) filling about 60% of the height. Building only, nothing around it, no ground, no text, transparent background.
